chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0056: Ji Ning Passes the Third Trial and Meets the Artifact Spirit
chapter_meta_description: At the brink of death, Ji Ning’s desperate gamble pays off as he wounds the ancient guardian and becomes the new master of the aquatic palace. An artifact spirit explains the true rarity of his feat.
og_title: Victory and a New Legacy: Ji Ning’s Desperate Gamble Pays Off
og_description: After a brutal trial, Ji Ning’s unique combination of Divine Sense and Fiendgod regeneration secures him a victory. An ancient artifact spirit confirms his unprecedented achievement.
